messages:
Eve: quick micro-triage here 1 post-launch. three customer items landed this morning, need to slot into sprints and draft comms.

Noah: paste the items?

Eve: copy from support: 
```
RD-9001  embeddings drop for docs >1MB (CustX)
RD-9005  dedicated pool cold-start spike (CustY)
RD-9012  request-level metadata ignored by reranker (multiple customers)
```

Linh: initial read: RD-9001 looks like a regression (used to work). RD-9005 is infra cost/regression, high impact for a few large customers. RD-9012 is clearly an enhancement with API implications.

Diego: SRE note 1 RD-9005: cold-start spike correlates with GPU eviction events when scale-up happens. Short-term mitigation: increase min-replicas for dedicated pools for affected customers. That's a config change but will increase spend.

Hannah: PM side: CustX is asking for ETA publicly. If RD-9001 is P0 we should prioritize. RD-9012 could be scoped as v1 that only preserves top-level fields; that would be quick.

Eve: proposal:
- Sprint A (this 2w): RD-9001 hotfix + canary (owner: Linh). RD-9005 mitigation as ops config flip for impacted customers (owner: Diego). RD-9012 scoping doc only.
- Sprint B: full RD-9012 implementation and tests, infra work to reduce cold-start cost if exec asks.

Noah: +1 for that split. If Linh takes RD-9001 she needs 3 dev-days and 1 QA day. We should bump one low-priority enhancement out to make room.

Linh: I'll take RD-9001. Acceptance criteria: failing repro added to harness, unit test cover reproducer, 5% canary for 48h, metrics back to baseline.

Diego: I'll open a SOP for the config flip and list customers that will see increased min-replicas. Ops watchers will need to sign off.

Hannah: I'll draft customer notes: CustX = "we're shipping a hotfix this sprint; canary ETA 48h after release." CustY = "we've enabled a mitigation; follow-up infra work planned."

OpsBot: Ticket RD-9300 created by Eve: "post-launch micro-triage: RD-9001 hotfix + RD-9012 scoping"

Noah: please add timelines to the roadmap board and mark any cost implications in the owner field.

Eve: will do. tagging weekly triage for follow-up. thanks team.

Diego: I'll notify billing if we flip min-replicas for CustY.

Linh: will open PR with repro attached by EOD tomorrow.

Hannah: +1
